capabilities: Display the local graph inline within the note content
Toggle outgoing and incoming links independently
Zoom the graph with a control bar
Open linked notes by clicking nodes
Style node shape, color, font size, and label truncation
extras: Uses the vis-network.js library to render the graph; mouse-wheel zooming is disabled by design so note scrolling is not trapped inside the graph; UI localized in English, Korean, and Japanese.
intentEvidence: Obsidian's local graph lives in a side panel — you have to open it, resize it, and look away
motivation: The author wanted the local graph in unused space at the bottom of the note, where the reader's eyes already are, avoiding the side panel context switch.
problem: Obsidian's local graph lives in a side panel, so you must open it, resize it, and look away from the note you are reading.
summary: Renders an interactive local graph of the current note's links and backlinks inline at the top or bottom of the note.
